full_judgment:
9. In support of title and possession the petitioners annexed the SA Khatians regarding the schedule property (Annexures A/2 and A/3 to the writ petition). Although those khatians were recorded in the name of petitioners' predecessor but nature of the schedule property has been mentioned as "SHIKOSHTI BHUMI". The Government developed the said shikosti land and constructed flood control embankment. This being the position according the record of right question arise who is entitled to the said property in view of Section 86 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act (the Act, 1950). In this regard we have gone through the case of Human Rights and Peace for Bangladesh and others Vs. Bangladesh and others reported in 14 BLC page 759 wherein their Lordships held as under: 

 Since the records of right described the property as shihkoshti land (under water) and therefore, in view of Section 86 of the Act, 1950 and the ratio as quoted above, it is vested upon the Government and that on such consideration the petitioners are not entitled to have compensation for the schedule property.
